candidate_ladder.purpose: freeze enough pre-outcome citation-ranked candidates to tolerate up to 80% screening attrition before an explicit versioned expansion is required
candidate_ladder.expansion_if_exhausted: versioned pre-decomposition expansion allowed only from eligibility/source-access attrition; never from decomposition outcomes

matching_order: normalized DOI exact match when both candidate and seed DOI exist
normalized title plus publication year exact match

screening.quota_rule: first k_d INCLUDE works in frozen ladder order

reserve.prefreeze_screening_continuation: candidate ladder continues until first k_d INCLUDE works or ladder exhaustion
reserve.reason: after corpus freeze, extraction/IR/decomposition failures remain explicit failure states and denominators rather than triggering work replacement

terminal_failure.blocker: OpenAlex HTTP 500 on direct frozen-union citation-ranked request
